titleEn: Cosmic rays: the invisible "bullets" bombarding Earth every second
summaryEn:
Right now, as you read this article, secondary particles produced by cosmic rays are passing through the atmosphere and through our bodies. Most of them cannot be felt at all.

Despite the word "ray", cosmic rays are mostly not light. They are particles and atomic nuclei carrying very high energy, moving through space at speeds that can approach the speed of light.
